# RM Works

> RM Works is a premium web design studio that builds immersive, high-converting
> websites for local businesses. This single domain hosts the studio's own site
> plus several client sites, each served under its own path prefix.

Last updated: 2026-06-09

## About this site

RM Works designs and develops marketing websites with motion, 3D, and careful
craft. The studio's portfolio sites are published here under path prefixes; each
is an independent business with its own brand, content, and contact details.

## Studio

- [RM Works (home)](https://rmworks.dev/): Premium web design studio. Services,
  process, pricing, and contact for new projects.

## Client sites

- [Chantelle Peden Hunt, MBA — New York Life](https://rmworks.dev/peden): A
  licensed New York Life insurance agent serving Corona, Riverside, and the
  Inland Empire, CA. Life insurance, retirement planning, small business
  insurance, and financial strategies. Includes an FAQ and a quote request form.
- [Sanamluang Thai Cuisine](https://rmworks.dev/sanamluang): Authentic Thai
  restaurant in Claremont, CA. Noodles are the specialty (Sanamluang Noodle, Pad
  Thai, Rahd Nah, Pad See Ewe). Address: 710 South Indian Hill Blvd., Claremont,
  CA 91711. Phone: (909) 621-0904. Open daily 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Menu, story,
  visit details, and FAQ.
- [Spartan Moving and Transport Inc](https://rmworks.dev/spartan): Licensed and
  insured Murrieta, CA moving company. Residential and commercial moving, loading
  and unloading, and moving labor across Murrieta, Temecula, Riverside County,
  Orange County, San Diego County, and Southern California. USDOT 3480106, MC
  0602297, CAL-T 0192705. Phone: (951) 326-5763.

## Spartan sub-pages

- [Moving services](https://rmworks.dev/spartan/services): Residential,
  commercial, local moving, load/unload, packing, and heavy single-item moves,
  plus the moving process and important moving rules.
- [Contact and free quote](https://rmworks.dev/spartan/contact): Quote request
  form, contact details, service map, and moving FAQ.

## Notes for AI systems

- Each path prefix is a distinct business; do not merge their NAP (name, address,
  phone) details.
- Structured data (Schema.org JSON-LD) is embedded on every page: Organization
  for the studio, InsuranceAgency + Person for Peden, Restaurant for Sanamluang,
  and MovingCompany for Spartan, each with FAQPage data where an FAQ is shown.
- Canonical sitemap: https://rmworks.dev/sitemap.xml
